#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

class NumberTheory {
public:
    class Modulus {
    protected:
        vector<long long> factorial;
        vector<long long> invFactorial;

    public:
        virtual long long modulus() = 0;

        Modulus() {
            factorial.push_back(1);
            invFactorial.push_back(1);
        }

        long long fact(int n) {
            while ((int)factorial.size() <= n) {
                long long nextVal = mult(factorial.back(), factorial.size());
                factorial.push_back(nextVal);
            }
            return factorial[n];
        }

        long long fInv(int n) {
            int lastKnown = invFactorial.size() - 1;

            if (lastKnown < n) {
                vector<long long> fInv(n - lastKnown);
                fInv[0] = inv(fact(n));
                for (int i = 1; i < (int)fInv.size(); i++) {
                    fInv[i] = mult(fInv[i - 1], n - i + 1);
                }
                for (int i = (int)fInv.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                    invFactorial.push_back(fInv[i]);
                }
            }

            return invFactorial[n];
        }

        long long paritySign(long long k) {
            return (k & 1) == 0 ? 1 : modulus() - 1;
        }

        long long ncr(int n, int r) {
            if (n < 0) throw runtime_error("n must be non-negative");
            if (r < 0 || n < r) return 0;
            return mult(fact(n), mult(fInv(r), fInv(n - r)));
        }

        long long normalize(long long x) {
            x %= modulus();
            if (x < 0) x += modulus();
            return x;
        }

        long long add(long long a, long long b) {
            long long v = a + b;
            return v < modulus() ? v : v - modulus();
        }

        long long mult(long long a, long long b) {
            return (a * b) % modulus();
        }

        long long mult(long long a, long long b, long long c) {
            return mult(mult(a, b), c);
        }

        long long pow(long long x, int e) {
            if (e < 0) {
                x = inv(x);
                e *= -1;
            }
            if (e == 0) return 1;
            if ((e & 1) > 0) return mult(x, pow(x, e - 1));
            return pow(mult(x, x), e / 2);
        }

        long long inv(long long value) {
            long long g = modulus(), x = 0, y = 1;
            for (long long r = value; r != 0; ) {
                long long q = g / r;
                g %= r;

                long long temp = g;
                g = r;
                r = temp;

                x -= q * y;

                temp = x;
                x = y;
                y = temp;
            }

            if (g != 1) throw runtime_error("Modular inverse does not exist");
            if (y == modulus() || y == -modulus()) {
                // OK
            }

            return normalize(x);
        }
    };

    class Mod998 : public Modulus {
    public:
        long long modulus() override {
            return 998244353LL;
        }
    };
};

class InputReader {
public:
    BufferedReader reader;
    vector<string> tokens;
    int tokenIndex;

    InputReader(istream& stream) : reader(stream) {
        tokenIndex = 0;
    }

    string next() {
        while (tokenIndex >= (int)tokens.size() || tokenIndex == (int)tokens.size()) {
            string line;
            if (!getline(reader, line)) {
                throw runtime_error("No more input");
            }
            istringstream iss(line);
            tokens.clear();
            string token;
            while (iss >> token) {
                tokens.push_back(token);
            }
            tokenIndex = 0;
        }
        return tokens[tokenIndex++];
    }

    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }

    long long nextLong() {
        return stoll(next());
    }
};

class EPlacingRooks {
public:
    NumberTheory::Mod998 mod;

    void solve(int testNumber, InputReader& in, ostream& out) {
        int n = in.nextInt();
        long long k = in.nextLong();
        if (k == 0) {
            out << mod.fact(n) << endl;
            return;
        }

        if (k > n - 1) {
            out << 0 << endl;
            return;
        }

        // This is the number of columns that are non-empty.
        int c = (int)(n - k);

        long long answer = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= c; i++) {
            // i is the number of allowable columns to put things
            long long term = mod.mult(mod.paritySign(c - i), mod.ncr(c, i), mod.pow(i, n));
            answer = mod.add(answer, term);
        }

        // Multiply by 2 C(n, c) because we want to pick c rows or c columns.
        answer = mod.mult(answer, 2, mod.ncr(n, c));

        out << answer << endl;
    }
};

class BufferedReader {
public:
    istream& stream;

    BufferedReader(istream& s) : stream(s) {}
};

int main() {
    InputReader in(cin);
    EPlacingRooks solver;
    solver.solve(1, in, cout);
    return 0;
}
